actualCoverage.readMethod: Read all 50 Chinese sourceText and Japanese text blocks, title and six notes in ranges 0-16,17-33,34-49. Independently read entire local Guiyou chapter 24, lines 4397-4622. Consulted Japanese chapter 85 dialogue register and inherited chapter 81 style sample.

changes.before: 裏の廊下の五番目の嫂さんの息子
changes.after: 裏の廊下沿いに住む五番目の嫂さんの息子
changes.reason: Restore 住: identifies a residence, not simply the location of a family rank.

changes.before: 銀児、向かいの王おばさんに
changes.after: 銀姐、向かいの王おばさんに
changes.reason: Correct the daughter name to match 银姐 in both the current source and Guiyou witness; no source change.

changes.before: 何分か何銭か使えば、それでも精いっぱいです。
changes.after: 何分、何銭というわずかな量を使うだけでも、精いっぱいです。
changes.reason: These units describe the quantity of expensive aromatics, not coins spent. Make the referent explicit.

changes.before: それでは私の孝心が報われません。
changes.after: それでは私の孝心を取り違えておいでです。
changes.reason: 辜负 here challenges her reading of his gift as interested, rather than asking for a reward.

changes.before: その一刻ばかり、部屋には宝玉一人しかいなかった。
changes.after: ちょうどそのわずかな間、部屋には宝玉一人しかいなかった。
changes.reason: 一刻的工夫 means a brief interval in this context, not an asserted clock duration.

checkedAndRetained: Jia Yun age eighteen and generation-rank joke; visits and courtesy hierarchy.
Four liang each of borneol and musk as requested quantities, cash-credit refusal, twenty-liang penalty, eight-month repayment promise.

Ni Er lending without interest or contract, estimated fifteen liang three qian plus remainder versus exact fifteen liang three qian four fen two li; repayment equals principal, not imagined double amount.
Fengjie manipulation, Jia Yun invented gift story, purchased office and Yunnan posting, two hundred liang grant and fifty liang tree purchase.
Named servants, Beiming/Mingyan variant, four or five companions despite four listed names, servant absence reasons and Xiaohong name taboo.
Handkerchief encounter and closing suspense retained without disclosing the next chapter explanation.

candidates.issue: Guiyou adds dismissal from shop to the twenty-liang penalty.
candidates.decision: Do not import addition; current source punishment retained.

candidates.issue: Guiyou wording about remaining field and rooms differs.
candidates.decision: Retain present source rhetorical denial; no source emendation.

candidates.issue: Current source five carts; Guiyou four or five, with black donkey detail.
candidates.decision: Keep five carts and no added color; forty or fifty clerics is character speech, not corrected to prior chapter count.

candidates.issue: Current 这不是话; Guiyou 这才是了.
candidates.decision: Retain existing contextual agreement translation and explicit note; Chinese unchanged.

candidates.issue: Guiyou repeats four liang each in gift story; current source only says some.
candidates.decision: No quantities imported into this speech.

candidates.issue: Guiyou has 茗烟 and 三间书房; current source 焙茗 with no room count.
candidates.decision: Keep 焙茗 and no added room count.

candidates.issue: Guiyou expands explanation of messengers lack of time.

guiyouComparison.comments: Bracketed commentary excluded from narration; witness evaluated as a candidate regardless of authenticity.

limitations: No Chinese, traditional Chinese, English, or other chapter changes.
Unresolved variants remain explicitly annotated; complete draft does not mean source-critical closure.
